Name: Metalcore Goes Cottagecore - East Scarp Addon
Author: ottersqueaks
Description:
[quote]Tucked away in the old cove is a woman living one day at a time. Always on her unsteady feet, her only companions are her old service dog and a chicken that seems to stare through you.[/quote]

Metalcore Goes Cottagecore is an add-on to East Scarp that brings in Cambria and her pets! This mod includes 7 events, a new special order, a new crop, and more to come in future updates.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HnYQxTXx/Camie.png[/img]﻿    [img]https://i.postimg.cc/D0N8ThcR/orchidplate.png[/img]    [img]https://i.postimg.cc/4yymqypz/jupiter.png[/img]

[b]Name[/b]: Cambria Lilian Castlegrove
[b]Nicknames[/b]: Camie, Castle
[b]Age[/b]: 32
[b]Birthday[/b]: Winter 11
[b]Height[/b]: 5'10"/178cm
[b]Pronouns[/b]: She/Her
[b]Residence[/b]: Old Castlegrove Residence in Lore's Cove
[b]Personality[/b]: Closed off, but friendly. Has a motherly side and puts everyone before herself.
[b]Occupation[/b]: Currently - Beekeeper and coffee farmer. Formerly - Tattoo artist and metalcore singer.
[b]Romanceable[/b]: Yes - Dating only

[b]Name[/b]: Orchid[b]
Age[/b]: ???
[b]Personality[/b]: Attuned to the void and [i]will[/i] make it everyone else's problem. Prefers corn chips over people, and yes that is a threat.[b]
Occupation[/b]: Currently - Seat warmer and general prankster. Formerly - [Data Expunged]

[b]Name[/b]: Jupiter[b]
Age[/b]: 10ish[b]
Personality[/b]: Don't trust him with your money. Who said old dogs can't learn new tricks?
[b]Occupation[/b]: Currently - Loafer and squirrel chaser. Formerly - Service and emotional support.

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38116]PC's Tilesheets[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list]
Cambria can be encountered right away, though her schedule can take her all over town. It's recommended to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19305]Schedule Viewer [/url]﻿to see where she is.

Other recommended mods are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup [/url][or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39885]MH Event List[/url]] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿ for keeping track of content.

[b]Config[/b] [b]Options[/b]:
[spoiler][b]PortraitStyle
[/b]Choose what portrait style to use for Cambria

[b]Exclude from Perfection
[/b]Keep MGC items from being necessary to reach perfection

[b]Cambria Romantic Nickname
[/b]Custom term of endearment for the player. Default is 'Starlight' but can be edited per preference.[/spoiler]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/m2ZpsZPs/Known-Issues-text.png[/img]

[quote]Special order is accessible but impossible to complete[/quote]The special order is supposed to be available after unlocking Cambria's greenhouse and fishing up a void salmon for the first time. If it is accepted early, it will not expire and the player can have it in their journal until they're able to complete it.

[quote]Cambria's Greenhouse is inaccessible[/quote]Cambria's greenhouse is unlocked after seeing part 2 of her 4 hearts event [hint: she's playing guitar at Lore's Cove]. If it still isn't unlocked, enter this command in the smapi console:
[spoiler]debug seenmail CambriaGreenhouse[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/G23kbQ5v/Compatibility-text.png[/img]

Metalcore Goes Cottagecore is fully compatible with expansion mods like Stardew Valley Expanded, Sunberry Village, Ridgeside Village, and plenty of others.

Please report any incompatibility with other mods.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W4gVd5ZW/Future-Updates-text.png[/img]

[b]2/14/2026 Note[/b]: Due to growing scope, Daehyun will now be moved to his own mod. He will still be involved with MGC and have crossover content when both mods are installed. Please look forward to it. <3

Compatibility is an ongoing project. Right now, Cambria has dialogue for a handful of custom events and with certain add-ons.

[b]Character Teasers[/b]:
[spoiler][b]Name[/b]: Gabriel Bang
[b]Age[/b]: 29
[b]Bio[/b]: Cambria's best friend and roommate in the city. He starts to visit on his houseboat later in the story.

[b]Name[/b]: Livani
[b]Age[/b]: ???
[b]Bio[/b]: Don't go looking into things you shouldn't, child.

[i]While not completely removed, their role in the story is adjusted to allow for romance content.[/i]
[s][b]Name[/b]: Darien Storms
[b]Age[/b]: 30
[b]Bio[/b]: Cambria's long-term boyfriend and father to Dolly. He wishes she would
return to the city and sees her life in the country as short-term.

[b]Name[/b]: Dolly Storms
[b]Age[/b]: 8
[b]Bio[/b]: Daughter to Darien and sees Cambria as a mother figure. Struggles with life in the city and misses her mama a lot.[/s][/spoiler]
